text:
carla: Heads-up — post-deploy in eu-west we started seeing 502s from the svc during a node drain. deploy-bot posted an automated rollback hold because max-evict-time hit 45s.
deploy-bot: Automated action: staging->production promotion stalled. Suggested action: rollback in 5m unless a manual pin is requested. (reason: 502 spike during pod eviction) :warning:
carla: I'm investigating; the drain coincided with a batch of DNS rebalances to the new ASG. Pods are still pending on azure PV attach. Not a release code regression yet.
sre-oncall: If PV attach is the blocker we can extend the eviction window but need a manual pin to keep this release online. Traffic is at ~5% error spike but not global.
alice: Can we add a temporary fallback route to stable and keep the canary running? That buys time while infra finishes attaching.
ben: Fallback route needs a short rollback window configured in deploy-bot otherwise it will auto-rollback and wipe release notes. If you want to avoid rollback, run the manual pin flow now.
carla: Proposed action: run pin, annotate the helmrelease to pause automated rollbacks, create a follow-up ticket for infra to re-run PV attach and node-drain backlog. If we still see errors after 30m we rollback.
alice: +1. How do we pin quickly?
ben: Command I used last time: ```kubectl annotate helmrelease srvc-api-v3 release.redwood/pinned-by="carla" release.redwood/pin-reason="evacuation-pv-attach" --overwrite``` then `deployctl rollout patch srvc-api-v3 --pause-automated-rollback=true`.
deploy-bot: Acknowledge. If a manual pin annotation is present, automated rollback will be suppressed for up to 60m. Please confirm who is authorizing.
sre-oncall: Authorizing: sre-oncall. I'll keep an eye on error budgets and remove pin early if needed.
carla: Done. Applied annotation and patched rollout. Adding a short release-note entry: "temporary pause: pin due to node drain / PV attach in eu-west; monitoring infra recovery; rollback if persists beyond 30m".
alice: I'll update the release notes and send a short blurb to #product-notifications.
ben: I also uploaded a one-line entry to the changelog: "hotfix: pinned release during node-drain to avoid premature rollback".
carla: Thanks. Leaving monitoring on. If we're green by +25m I'll unpin and let promotion finish. If errors remain we'll rollback at +30m as discussed. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Note: scheduled automated rollback suppressed for this thread until 1767015945 (60m TTL). Manual unpin command: `kubectl annotate helmrelease srvc-api-v3 release.redwood/pinned-by- -`
carla: Copy. Ticket created: INFRA-2147 — re-run PV attach and requeue node-drain. Linking here.
sre-oncall: I'll post a short postmortem if we hit rollback. For now monitoring looks stable at 10m.
carla: Closing thread for now — will update when pin removed or rollback executed."
